jem_summary: Cause a Burned to change into its obsidian form with water and defeat that form.

pages.title: Water Changes the Fight
pages.text: Cause a Burned to change into its obsidian form with water and defeat that form.

pages.title: Water Changes the Fight
pages.text: Deliberately change an enemy’s state, then adapt your combat approach.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Obsidian form has projectile immunity and different mobility; lava can reignite it. Immortal separately changes with thunderstorms/lightning: its loot is not identical in every weather.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Water/lava changes Burned; storms/lightning changes Immortal. Their conditions and rewards differ.
